messages:
maria_devrel: Heads-up: planning a compact dev-content push (week of May 12). Ask: two short tutorial vids, a tiny reference app, reproducible benchmark post, webinar, and clear lead routing.
ben_marketing: Good. Timeline? Need to lock dates for promos.
ashley_growth: Aim to start promos May 5. Email cadence: -10, -3, day-of, +1.
tom_engineer: I'll own the ref app and bench script. Expect a Docker example + run_bench.sh.
katie_content: Benchmark post: single comparative chart, <900 words, plus commands to reproduce.
maria_devrel: Routing rule idea: form fields company_size, use_case, compliance -> leads-bot routes enterprise vs community.
leads-bot: Recommend: if company_size > 200 OR compliance contains "on-prem"/"SOC2" -> route to #sales-inbound; else -> #community-onboarding. Preserve utm_source and utm_campaign.
ben_marketing: I'll add domain-based enterprise tagging list to the repo.
ashley_growth: SLA: AE reach out within 24h for sales-tagged leads. Community gets automated welcome + tutorial link.
tom_engineer: For reproducibility include hardware note and exact command: `./run_bench.sh --model redwood-mini --seq 512 --iters 200`.
katie_content: I'll draft blog + chart. Product review required before publish.
ben_marketing: Promo plan: blog, Twitter thread, LinkedIn posts, partner newsletter. All CTAs -> webinar page with form.
maria_devrel: Drop one deliverable + ETA here and I'll add to the board.
ben_marketing: Landing page + form (with hidden utm fields)  ETA Wed Apr 30.
tom_engineer: Ref app + bench script + Dockerfile  ETA Wed Apr 30.
katie_content: Benchmark draft + PNGs  ETA Fri May 2.
ashley_growth: Email templates + ads creative  ETA Mon Apr 27.
maria_devrel: One rule: keep benchmark language factual and reproducible. I'll open a PR for routing rules later today. :rocket:
